text: {"lessons":["Before reversing a position, write down what has changed in my view; selling Stock E at a large loss and later buying it again is a reason to make exits and re-entries deliberate.","Set target position sizes and review them before placing large orders, so each trade fits the portfolio rather than becoming an impulse-sized bet.","Judge progress against my ten-year apartment goal and savings plan, not by how active I am or by short-term account swings."]}
